Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Updated November 15, 2023: To simplify the user experience and make Copilot more accessible to everyone, Bing Chat and Bing Chat Enterprise will now simply become Microsoft Copilot. Today at Microsoft Inspire , we’re excited to unveil the next steps in our journey: First, we’re significantly expanding Bing to reach new audiences with Bing Chat Enterprise, delivering AI-powered chat for work, and rolling out today in Preview – which means that more than 160 million people already have access. And, in the future, Bing Chat Enterprise will also be accessible from Windows Copilot. Editor’s note: As of Aug. 21, we have extended Bing Chat Enterprise eligibility to Microsoft 365 A3 and A5 licenses for faculty. Do not use remembered later prices or invent expectations, exposures or orders. This target starts at the next executable regular-session OPEN and ends at the fifth session CLOSE, counting entry as one. Do not count the initial overnight or earlier announcement reaction as a future return. We predict RAW price movement, including ordinary market movement, not the article's isolated causal effect. An unrelated article or missing information does not imply a flat stock: use the supplied market reference and ordinary volatility. Flat is a narrow realized +/-1% band over five sessions, never an expression of ignorance. Express uncertainty through up/flat/down probabilities rather than concentrating probability on flat. Estimate the complete distribution of this future five-session return. Use pre-cutoff market trend, relative trend and volatility as the starting reference. Ask whether the supplied news gives additional evidence about continuation or reversal AFTER the entry open. Good business news alone is not proof of subsequent appreciation; bad business news may already be reflected.
